cs.t: My personal setup is:     - Wired headphones   - Speakers (Creative Pebble) when doing group meeting   - USB microphone (Fifine). It is directional and does not pick up everything in the room. I put it on a boom arm attached to my desk for quick positioning.    No Bluetooth, no earbuds with microphone, no internal microphones. Although, when I'm away from my desk, my wired headphones has a mic. But it's a better one than what I've seen on some earbuds.
